_note: Seal Whisper advisor settings. weights = what one unit is worth to you (FE). base* and rarityWeight/otherLoot are ASSUMPTIONS until measured from Bride chest loot (see 09-card-advisor.md). Weights from Trade House price checks in the log, 2026-10-25 (p10 of listings, see prices-from-log-2026-10-25.json): Scraps 0.076; Threads 0.6 (Magic 0.010 / Rare 0.042 / Epic 0.69, and 46 of 48 threads picked up were Epic); Hero Memories 0.06 = measured salvage value (2026-10-25: a fresh memory salvages to exactly 1 Thread, 47% Normal / 36% Magic / 11% Rare / 7% Epic; levelled memories are worth far more, that is the gamble; kept current by `npm run calibrate` from black-sail-salvage.jsonl); Invitations 18 = Craving; Black Sail only drops Craving (player-confirmed; Ecstasy 31.9 / Sorrow 17 come from bosses outside Black Sail). Base chest: run `npm run calibrate` to fit baseAmount (and the look-ahead's flames/doubledRate) from tool/data/history; the first numbers came from 8 Terminal chests (avg 147 Scraps / 5.9 Threads / 22.9 Hero Memories / 0.125 Invitations, boosts included). Scraps and Hero Memories appeared in 8/8 chests and Threads in 7/8, so baseAppear is near 1 (chance-to-appear effects add little) and baseAmount = average / 1.3 / appear.

salvage._note: Hero Memory value = what salvaging a fresh drop returns: Threads per memory by tier (ConfigBaseId 5141 Normal? / 5142 Magic / 5143 Rare / 5144 Epic) times these prices, plus Scraps. Measured from black-sail-salvage.jsonl by `npm run calibrate` (memory-only batches without Scraps, since Scraps mean a levelled memory); needs minMemories before it overwrites weights.heroMemories. 5141's price is a guess (not price-checked yet).

lookahead._note: Future screens for the look-ahead. offerRarity/offerTypes = mix of the cards not guaranteed by a flame (36 screens, 2026-10-25: Wealth 46 / Armament 22 / Wonder 21 / Boss 15 cards, Boss only via a flame). flames = how often the player puts in a flame that guarantees a card of that group and minimum rarity (from black-sail-flames.jsonl). doubledRate = share of screens where every card shows '(Effect has doubled)' (the pet doubles the whole screen; 4 of 36 screens). tieFraction = cards within this share of the best card's expected value are shown as a tie. flames and doubledRate are rewritten by `npm run calibrate`.

goals._note: Chosen per cycle in the overlay. A focus goal multiplies its material's weight by focusBoost and every other material (and other loot) by othersFactor, so the advisor stacks that material and uses the rest only to break ties. 'fe' = plain FE weights. alwaysFull: invitations keep their full FE value under any goal (rare: 1 Craving in 8 chests, 18 FE; player guidance: take a good invitation card whatever the goal).
